title: I Leaned On The School Wall And Fell Into The Backrooms #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you lean against the wall in your school corridor.
And you fall straight through it.
You land in a yellow room. Old carpet. Buzzing lights.
There's another yellow room behind it. And another. And another.
No windows. No doors. Just the hum.
You walk for an hour. Every room is the same.
Then you find a backpack on the floor.
It's yours. Your name is on it. It's covered in dust.
Inside is a note in your handwriting: "Don't follow the footsteps."
*Behind you, something starts walking. Exactly in step with you.
Would you run, or stand completely still? Comment A or B.
